001
002package dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.node;
003
004import dev.metaschema.core.util.ObjectUtils;
005import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.Nullable;
006
007/**
008 * A common base class for node item implementations.
009 */
010public abstract class AbstractNodeItem implements INodeItem {
011
012  /**
013   * Generates a string signature for this node item in the format:
014   * {@code type\u2ABBlocation_metapath\u2ABC} or
015   * {@code type\u2ABBlocation_metapath\u2ABC(value)} where:
016   * <ul>
017   * <li>type: The node type signature
018   * <li>location_metapath: A Metapath for the node's location in the document
019   * <li>value: Optional value signature if a value is present
020   * </ul>
021   * The special characters \u2ABB and \u2ABC are used as delimiters to clearly
022   * separate the type from the location Metapath expression.
023   *
024   * @return the string signature of this node item
025   */
026  @SuppressWarnings("checkstyle:AvoidEscapedUnicodeCharacters")
027  @Override
028  public final String toSignature() {
029    StringBuilder builder = new StringBuilder()
030        .append(getType().toSignature())
031        .append('\u2ABB')
032        .append(getMetapath())
033        .append('\u2ABC');
034    String value = getValueSignature();
035    if (value != null) {
036      builder.append('(')
037          .append(value)
038          .append(')');
039    }
040    return ObjectUtils.notNull(builder.toString());
041  }
042
043  /**
044   * Get the signature of this node's value.
045   *
046   * @return the value's signature or {@code null} if the node has no value
047   */
048  @Nullable
049  protected abstract String getValueSignature();
050
051  @Override
052  public final String toString() {
053    return toSignature();
054  }
055}
